    66  ### General Euler Products

    68  In this section we consider multiplicative (on coprime arguments) functions `f : ℕ → R`,
    69  where `R` is a complete normed commutative ring. The main result is `EulerProduct.eulerProduct`.
    70  -/

    84  /-- We relate a finite product over primes in `s` to an infinite sum over `s`-factored numbers. -/
    85  lemma summable_and_hasSum_factoredNumbers_prod_filter_prime_tsum
    86      (hsum : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime → Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ ‖f (p ^ n)‖)) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    87      Summable (fun m : factoredNumbers s ↦ ‖f m‖) ∧
    88        HasSum (fun m : factoredNumbers s ↦ f m)
    89          (∏ p ∈ s with p.Prime, ∑' n : ℕ, f (p ^ n)) := by
    90    induction s using Finset.induction with
    91    | empty =>
    92      rw [factoredNumbers_empty]
    93      simp only [notMem_empty, IsEmpty.forall_iff, forall_const, filter_true_of_mem, prod_empty]
    94      exact ⟨(Set.finite_singleton 1).summable (‖f ·‖), hf₁ ▸ hasSum_singleton 1 f⟩
    95    | insert p s hp ih =>
    96      rw [filter_insert]
    97      split_ifs with hpp
    98      · constructor
    99        · simp only [← (equivProdNatFactoredNumbers hpp hp).summable_iff, Function.comp_def,
   100            equivProdNatFactoredNumbers_apply', factoredNumbers.map_prime_pow_mul hmul hpp hp]
   101          refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun _ ↦ norm_mul_le ..) ?_
   102          apply Summable.mul_of_nonneg (hsum hpp) ih.1 <;> exact fun n ↦ norm_nonneg _

   105          conv =>
   106            enter [1, x]
   107            rw [equivProdNatFactoredNumbers_apply', factoredNumbers.map_prime_pow_mul hmul hpp hp]
   108          have : T3Space R := instT3Space -- speeds up the following
   109          apply (hsum hpp).of_norm.hasSum.mul ih.2

   206  If `f : ℕ → R`, where `R` is a complete normed commutative ring, `f 0 = 0`, `f 1 = 1`, `f` is
   207  multiplicative on coprime arguments, and `‖f ·‖` is summable, then
   208  `∏' p : {p : ℕ | p.Prime}, ∑' e, f (p ^ e) = ∑' n, f n`.
   209  This is a version using convergence of finite partial products. -/
   210  theorem eulerProduct (hsum : Summable (‖f ·‖)) (hf₀ : f 0 = 0) :
   211      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ∏ p ∈ primesBelow n, ∑' e, f (p ^ e)) atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, f n)) := by
   212    have := (eulerProduct_hasProd_mulIndicator hf₁ hmul hsum hf₀).tendsto_prod_nat
   213    let F : ℕ → R := fun p ↦ ∑' (e : ℕ), f (p ^ e)
   214    have H (n : ℕ) : ∏ i ∈ range n, Set.mulIndicator {p | Nat.Prime p} F i =
   215                       ∏ p ∈ primesBelow n, ∑' (e : ℕ), f (p ^ e) :=
   216      prod_mulIndicator_eq_prod_filter (range n) (fun _ ↦ F) (fun _ ↦ {p | Nat.Prime p}) id
   217    simpa only [F, H]

   225  theorem eulerProduct_tprod (hsum : Summable (‖f ·‖)) (hf₀ : f 0 = 0) :
